'''Irontree Cavern''' is a deep cave inhabited by [[Corrupted Warpwood Flayers]] and [[Warpwood Moss Flayers]]. Once can also collect [[Blood Amber]] from the 52-53 [[elementals]] for the quest {{quest|Cleansing Felwood|Cleansing Felwood}}. Down below is a 56 Elite named [[Dessecus]].
